description: Lists searches that found nothing good: queries by external callers in the last 90 days that returned no provider or only weak matches (best relevance below 0.62). Use this when you want searches Agentery could not answer well, as generalised job labels ranked by distinct callers. Most entries come from a single caller: treat those as leads. These are limited coverage signals from Agentery's own callers — not proof that a product does not exist, and not proof that a market has paying demand. Not a prerequisite for choosing a product. Empty args ({}) return the current list; an empty response means insufficient qualifying evidence (status insufficient_evidence + next_step) — it is never filled from search popularity, page views or trending queries. Use market_gaps instead for jobs that few paid products serve.

include_own.description: Also list signals that come ONLY from your own searches (default false; counted in your_own_only_excluded)

name: demand_signals

outputSchema.description: JSON result; identical to the text content block.
